items.s: Army veteran working for Brian Heder in the Keys. He leads Chapter 1 and is one of the two playable characters.
Released from Hamlet Prison at the start of the story, she teams up with Jason. She leads the prologue and Chapter 2.
Jason’s landlord and boss in Key Lento; a smuggler and the game’s first fence (Brian's Lockup). Married to Lori.
Brian’s wife. She appears in Swamped and Meet the Heders.
Jason’s friend and fishing buddy. His fishing challenge earns the Baited My Tackle trophy.

items.s: Grand Theft Auto VI is by Rockstar Games. It is set in Leonida, a fictional state inspired by Florida, with Vice City as its main city. It launches on November
It is described as a single-player experience at launch.
Rockstar confirmed 30 FPS on all platforms, including PS5 Pro.
Jason and Lucia. Switching between them is instant when they are together and takes a few seconds when they are apart.
Eating, working out and sleeping affect the protagonists’ physique and stats.
There is an in-game social network, radio and podcasts.

items.s: GTA VI is out now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It unlocked at local midnight in each region, with New Zealand playing first.
The 55-trophy list is out: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, with 28 hidden. It is worth 1,000G on Xbox.
The first full guides confirm a 175 km² map split into 5 counties, plus 557 vehicles, 196 weapons and 255 animals in the progress database.
Press reviews left a 99/100 Metacritic average, reported at launch as the highest ever for a video game.
Sensor Tower estimated about $1.54 billion in pre-order revenue from 16 million pre-orders. Take-Two shares rose about 6%.
PlayStation Network went down hours before launch. Xbox reported no issues.
